Oops, I think Jeff had a typo in the domain name. It's actually:

http://news.cis.dfn.de

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Replace the ".ne" with ".de".

You also have to register first (at the http://... site) in order
to get a username and password (which is required by the newsserver
in order to cut down on spam).

If it doesn't work at .de, try with another newsreader to verify that
it isn't a configuration problem with Outlook (like Netscape or
whatever).
